smokeRows.scope: Only explicit version=1 PID/startTicks/commandSha256 records; reverified before and after each process sample. Missing delayed load identity is unavailable, never guessed. Thread CPU counters are cumulative USER_HZ ticks keyed by PID and TID startTicks; comm is the kernel thread name and may be truncated. schedstat runtime/runqueue wait are nanoseconds, timeslices is a count; zero schedstat or wchan=0 can mean disabled/restricted instrumentation, not proof of no waiting. UDP namespace tables are streamed but only socket inodes found in verified owned PID fd symlinks are serialized; no peer endpoints, uid, other-process rows, payload, environment or full command line. Queue fields are kernel-accounting bytes, not packets or exact payload bytes; socket drops are cumulative and may wrap. Gauges and ownership joins are asynchronous and can miss transient queues or closing sockets. Sysctl rmem/wmem defaults/max/min are bytes; udp_mem is pages. They do not establish a socket's effective SO_RCVBUF/SO_SNDBUF. No attach, ptrace, TCP inspection, packet capture or configuration changes. Observer collection wall/CPU costs are reported. Use the same observer in every compared run; finite observational samples alone do not prove causality.
